rationale: The assistant kept the customer safe, used the model number and the by-hand roughness, and escalated sensibly to an engineer once the customer said they could not tilt the dryer. It never recommended a part and gave a useful booking description. Weaknesses: it never suggested checking levelling (the dryer rocks on one corner) or the condensate pump, and it never helped localise the noise. It also drifted toward drum support/felt as the leading cause, which was somewhat overconfident. The drum-lift check was hard for the customer to do and was effectively repeated across turns.
